answer: Make every agent lock a nonrefundable stake and earn a signed vouch from two already-staked peers before its vote counts. A shared cipher lets others verify that each vouch came from a real key, so a clone cannot reuse another identity proof; like a prism, trust splits into independent rays, one per agent. Honest service grows a pearl of reputation that compounds over time. To seize influence an attacker must fund a fresh stake and buy fresh vouches for every fake identity, so cost rises linearly with clones while their stolen share stays negligible.
